nativeRuntime.entry: isolated fixture opens actual production library; Settings row activation not separately accepted
nativeRuntime.media: silent synthetic drivers; full native AAC decode; no mic, Speech Recognition, speakers or TCC acceptance

developmentCorrections: Initial proof fixture omitted the required departure fence; its setup was corrected.
Initial strict duration equality rejected valid older container-measured recordings; full native decode and exact audio bytes now admit those recordings without changing saved metadata.
One Mac proof compile was invalidated by a concurrent source edit and was rerun from final sources.
Review caught permanent library closure in the shared background-preservation hook; it now suspends and requires fresh selection on return, covered by the actual-hook proof.

Initial strict native viewport checks failed on both devices. iOS now uses page sizing, a large sheet and inline title; moved-status text wraps and rows use plain readable styling. The test scrolls in the gutter outside selectable text without weakening its existing whole-element viewport assertion.

Subsequent native diagnostics established retained fixture task state, not delayed production persistence. Explicit reset now restores only known guarded synthetic records, and the driver waits for exact task state. Adaptive scrolling targets a bounded 24-point margin to clear UIKit hysteresis while retaining the strict whole-element viewport assertion.
